text: Dancing Wings on an Old Moonlit Night
While Jacky and the other kids were meeting up with\nNeewollah, someone suddenly interrupted them. She seems to\nbe called the "Crimson Moon Witch"...Let's fight her off!
You arrived in Risus Valley to pursue the "Crimson Moon\nWitch". The things you thought were wood turned out to be\nmonsters. Beat them to proceed!
You found yourself in an area inhabited by monsters looking\ndifferent from the wood monsters. Fight them off and find\nthe way to get to the next area!
As you proceed further, you found a river and a dead end. It\nseems to be the doing of the merman-looking monsters. Beat\nthem and destroy the wood and rocks blocking the water!
The "Crimson Moon Witch" said that offerings need to be made\nto see her and she kidnapped Jeila and the others.\nCollect the offerings depicted on the gate and go after her!
You finally reached the place where Jacky and the others are\nbeing held captive by the "Crimson Moon Witch".\nDefeat Eripmav to retrieve Pelulu's bag and the three kids!
